versions.content: RTE_E_COM_STOPPED – the RTE could not perform the operation because the communication service is currently not available (inter ECU communication only). RTE shall return RTE_E_COM_STOPPED when: – in case of COM the corresponding service returns COM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE – in case of LdCom the corresponding LdCom_Transmit re- turns E_NOT_OK The buffers of the return parameters shall not be modified.
